# Pampered Pooch

> Pampered Pooch is a one-person dog grooming business in Porthcawl, Wales, run by Sophie. I am a fully insured, qualified dog groomer and I opened on Victoria Avenue in April 2023. Grooming is by appointment only.

## Services and prices

- Full groom: bath, blow-dry, brush out, cut and style, nails and ears. From £40.
- Puppy sessions: a block of short, calm sessions that get puppies used to the table, the dryer and the clippers. From £30 per session.
- Bath and tidy: for between full grooms, a bath, dry, brush, and a tidy of the face, feet and bottom. From £25.
- Prices depend on size and coat condition. I reply to every enquiry with available times and a price for the groom.

## Location

- 17 Victoria Avenue, Porthcawl, Bridgend county, Wales, United Kingdom
- I groom dogs from Porthcawl, Bridgend, Pyle, Kenfig Hill, Nottage and Cornelly.
